Photo 2: close-up of the vented top panel and a side edge showing a small Xbox-shaped cutout, consistent with Xbox One S styling.
No power brick, HDMI cable, or box shown in any photo.

identity.kind: Xbox One S console with wireless controller

A black wireless-style controller is visible on top of the console in photos 0 and 1.
No photo shows the console powered on, a game library, or storage screen to confirm any installed games.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (overheating, disc drive failure, HDMI port issue)
risks.proof: A video or photo of the console powered on showing the Xbox home screen

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or original box included, which affects usability and resale value
risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick, HDMI cable, and any box included in the sale

risks.risk: Actual storage capacity could be less than claimed 1TB (could be 500GB model)
risks.proof: A photo of the rear/bottom capacity sticker or the console's storage settings screen
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common capacity variant (500GB)

risks.risk: Controller may not pair or have stick drift/battery issues
risks.proof: A video showing the controller paired and used on the console

risks.risk: Claimed pre-installed games could be pirated, trial versions, or tied to an account not transferred
risks.proof: A screenshot of the game library and confirmation of account transfer
risks.if_unproven: priced as no bundled games value

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on showing the Xbox home/dashboard screen
Photo of the rear/bottom sticker showing serial number and storage capacity
Photo showing power brick and HDMI cable included
Short clip of the controller paired and functioning with the console
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One S console with one controller from the photos, but none of the seller's key claims (1TB capacity, working condition, installed games, included cables) are verifiable from the images, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
